name: How long does trim repair and replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does trim repair and replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a single door casing or baseboard patch usually takes a few hours, while replacing trim across an entire room or floor can take one to three days. The overall duration depends on whether the project involves custom angle cuts, coping inside corners, and the extent of finishing work required. If our team needs to prep, patch surrounding drywall, caulk edges, fill nail holes, and apply finish paint coats, adequate dry times between steps are factored into the schedule. Small repairs are often wrapped up in a single handyman visit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs take a few hours, while whole-room or full-floor trim replacement generally takes one to three days, including drywall touch-ups, caulking, and painting.
